title: Emergency Services Schedule: Roof Tarping on HomeGuard Homeowners Policy Claims
content:
**Emergency tarping of a storm-damaged roof, HomeGuard Homeowners Policy.**

When wind or hail roof surfacing damage on a HomeGuard claim is re-settled from a below-deductible denial, emergency tarping is reimbursed. The amount depends on the whole days from the date of loss to the report date recorded on the claim's first-notice entry.

## Schedule

| Days from the date of loss to the report date | Emergency stage | Reimbursement |
|---|---|---|
| 0 to 3 | The desk's emergency vendor tarps the roof at first notice | 450.00 |
| 4 to 14 | The insured's own temporary covering, reimbursed at the desk's standard rate | 200.00 |
| 15 or more | Past the emergency stage | Nothing |

The reimbursement is a fixed dollar amount. It is added to the reversal payment on the roof surfacing before the payment is floored at 0.00 and rounded to the cent once.

## Counting the days

Days are whole calendar days, counting from the date of loss to the report date on the first notice. A loss reported the same day counts 0 days. A loss on 1 March reported on 4 March counts 3 days and is still within 3 days; one reported on 5 March counts 4 days.

## Edge figures (hypothetical dates)

| Date of loss | Report date | Days | Reimbursement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June | 10 June | 0 | 450.00 |
| 10 June | 13 June | 3 | 450.00 |
| 10 June | 14 June | 4 | 200.00 |
| 10 June | 24 June | 14 | 200.00 |
| 10 June | 25 June | 15 | Nothing |
